keyPoints.en: Atoms are too light to weigh directly, so we compare them with carbon-12.
keyPoints.bm: Atom terlalu ringan untuk ditimbang secara terus, jadi kita bandingkan dengan karbon-12.

keyPoints.en: RAM = average mass of one atom ÷ (1/12 × mass of one C-12 atom). It has no unit.
keyPoints.bm: JAR = purata jisim satu atom ÷ (1/12 × jisim satu atom C-12). Tiada unit.

keyPoints.en: RMM (or relative formula mass for ionic compounds) = sum of RAMs, e.g. NaCl = 23 + 35.5 = 58.5.
keyPoints.bm: JMR (atau jisim formula relatif bagi sebatian ion) = hasil tambah JAR, cth. NaCl = 23 + 35.5 = 58.5.

keyPoints.en: Carbon-12 is used because it is easy to handle, common and forms many compounds.
keyPoints.bm: Karbon-12 digunakan kerana mudah dikendalikan, banyak terdapat dan membentuk banyak sebatian.

question.en: Find the relative formula mass of CuSO₄·5H₂O. (Cu 64, S 32, O 16, H 1)
question.bm: Cari jisim formula relatif CuSO₄·5H₂O. (Cu 64, S 32, O 16, H 1)

tip.en: Multiply by the subscript AND any bracket number before adding.
tip.bm: Darab dengan subskrip DAN nombor kurungan sebelum menambah.

keyPoints.en: Molar mass (g mol⁻¹) has the same number as the RAM/RMM: 1 mol of H₂O weighs 18 g.
keyPoints.bm: Jisim molar (g mol⁻¹) sama nilai dengan JAR/JMR: 1 mol H₂O berjisim 18 g.

keyPoints.en: Mass ⇄ moles: n = m/M. Particles ⇄ moles: N = n × N_A.
keyPoints.bm: Jisim ⇄ mol: n = m/M. Zarah ⇄ mol: N = n × N_A.

keyPoints.en: For gases: V = n × 24 dm³ (room conditions) or n × 22.4 dm³ (STP).
keyPoints.bm: Bagi gas: V = n × 24 dm³ (keadaan bilik) atau n × 22.4 dm³ (STP).

keyPoints.en: Careful with molecules vs atoms: 1 mol of O₂ contains 2 mol of O atoms.
keyPoints.bm: Berhati-hati dengan molekul vs atom: 1 mol O₂ mengandungi 2 mol atom O.

question.en: How many hydrogen atoms are in 0.5 mol of H₂O?
question.bm: Berapakah bilangan atom hidrogen dalam 0.5 mol H₂O?

answer.en: 0.5 mol H₂O has 1 mol H atoms = 6.02 × 10²³ atoms
answer.bm: 0.5 mol H₂O mengandungi 1 mol atom H = 6.02 × 10²³ atom

tip.en: Always go through moles: mass → mol → particles or volume.
tip.bm: Sentiasa melalui mol: jisim → mol → zarah atau isi padu.

keyPoints.en: Empirical formula: simplest ratio. Molecular formula: actual atoms (C₂H₄ has empirical formula CH₂).
keyPoints.bm: Formula empirik: nisbah teringkas. Formula molekul: atom sebenar (C₂H₄ mempunyai formula empirik CH₂).

keyPoints.en: Find empirical formula: mass of each element → moles → divide by the smallest → whole numbers.
keyPoints.bm: Cari formula empirik: jisim setiap unsur → mol → bahagi dengan terkecil → nombor bulat.

keyPoints.en: Reactive metals (Mg, Zn): heat in a crucible in air. Less reactive (Cu, Pb, Sn): reduce the oxide with hydrogen.
keyPoints.bm: Logam reaktif (Mg, Zn): panaskan dalam mangkuk pijar di udara. Kurang reaktif (Cu, Pb, Sn): turunkan oksida dengan hidrogen.

keyPoints.en: Ionic formulas: balance the charges, e.g. Ca²⁺ + Cl⁻ → CaCl₂; Al³⁺ + SO₄²⁻ → Al₂(SO₄)₃.
keyPoints.bm: Formula ion: seimbangkan cas, cth. Ca²⁺ + Cl⁻ → CaCl₂; Al³⁺ + SO₄²⁻ → Al₂(SO₄)₃.

question.en: A compound has empirical formula CH₂ and RMM 56. Find its molecular formula.
question.bm: Sebatian mempunyai formula empirik CH₂ dan JMR 56. Cari formula molekulnya.

tip.en: In the Mg experiment, lift the lid now and then so air gets in, but don't let white fumes escape.
tip.bm: Dalam eksperimen Mg, angkat penutup sekali-sekala supaya udara masuk, tetapi jangan biarkan wasap putih terlepas.

keyPoints.en: A chemical equation shows reactants → products with state symbols (s), (l), (g), (aq).
keyPoints.bm: Persamaan kimia menunjukkan bahan → hasil dengan simbol keadaan (p), (ce), (g), (ak).

keyPoints.en: Balance by changing coefficients only — never change the formulas.
keyPoints.bm: Seimbangkan dengan menukar pekali sahaja — jangan ubah formula.

keyPoints.en: Coefficients give the mole ratio, e.g. 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O means 2 mol H₂ reacts with 1 mol O₂.
keyPoints.bm: Pekali memberi nisbah mol, cth. 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O bermakna 2 mol H₂ bertindak balas dengan 1 mol O₂.

keyPoints.en: Stoichiometry: given mass → moles → use ratio → moles of unknown → mass or volume.
keyPoints.bm: Stoikiometri: jisim diberi → mol → guna nisbah → mol yang dicari → jisim atau isi padu.

question.en: Zn + 2HCl → ZnCl₂ + H₂. What volume of H₂ (room conditions) forms from 6.5 g of zinc? (Zn = 65)
question.bm: Zn + 2HCl → ZnCl₂ + H₂. Berapakah isi padu H₂ (keadaan bilik) terhasil daripada 6.5 g zink? (Zn = 65)

tip.en: Check your balanced equation by counting each type of atom on both sides.
tip.bm: Semak persamaan seimbang dengan mengira setiap jenis atom di kedua-dua belah.
